headline: Argent LNG FEED, Shell offshore EPC in Malaysia, $2,218.8M Cernavodă nuclear award
hook: Three awards this week: FEED for a 25 mtpa US LNG terminal, a Shell offshore structures EPC in Malaysia and a $2,218.8M nuclear construction contract in Romania.
board: 85 new projects in 7 days across 46 countries: 51 awarded and 17 tenders. Energy leads with 57 and Europe with 34.
question: When a fabricator wins an offshore structures EPC, how far ahead of award do suppliers need to be on its vendor list?

items.headline: Argent LNG awards FEED for Port Fourchon LNG export terminal
items.statLabel: Proposed LNG export capacity, Port Fourchon
items.what: US LNG terminal developer Argent LNG has awarded the front-end engineering design (FEED) contract for its proposed LNG export terminal, LNG Prime reports.
items.who: Owner: Argent LNG. FEED: MAIRE's Tecnimont.
items.angle: This is an awarded FEED on a large LNG terminal, the design stage before an EPC award. It matters to LNG process equipment suppliers and EPC contractors who want to position early on new US export capacity.
facts: Planned capacity: 25 mtpa of LNG exports
Site: Port Fourchon, United States; reported 28 Sep 2026
items.watch: Further updates from Argent LNG or Tecnimont on FEED progress at Port Fourchon. The report gives no timeline.

items.headline: OceanMight wins Shell EPC for fixed offshore structures off Malaysia
items.statLabel: Combined value, Shell EPC plus two supply orders
items.what: Malaysian fabricator OceanMight has received a letter of award from Shell to engineer, procure and build fixed offshore structures for several field developments off Malaysia, per Splash247.
items.who: Owner: Shell. EPC: OceanMight (unit of KKB Engineering).
items.angle: This is an awarded EPC for offshore structures, so material buying and subcontracting come next. It matters to steel, materials and fabrication service suppliers in Malaysia's offshore oil and gas supply chain.
facts: Scope covers SK408 Teja and Pepulut plus the Temu and Inai fields
Combined value with two unrelated supply orders: about $113m
Supply orders from Hock Seng Lee and Bumia are due in Q4 2026
items.watch: Disclosure of the Shell contract period. The reported text cuts off before giving it, and KKB expects earnings to come over the contract term.

items.headline: Nuclearelectrica awards construction work at Cernavodă nuclear plant
items.statLabel: EU TED contract award, CNE Cernavodă
items.what: Nuclearelectrica has awarded a contract for nuclear power station construction work at CNE Cernavodă in Romania to a four-company association, per an EU TED notice.
items.who: Owner: Nuclearelectrica. Contractor: Candu Energy, Canadian Commercial Corporation, Ansaldo Nucleare, Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power.
items.angle: This is a large awarded nuclear construction contract, so subcontracting and equipment packages come next. It matters to civil, mechanical and electrical subcontractors and nuclear-qualified suppliers looking for work under the association.
facts: Members: Candu Energy, Canadian Commercial Corp., Ansaldo Nucleare, KHNP
The notice lists the awarded association as based in Canada
items.watch: The notice has no scope or schedule details. Look for disclosures on these from Nuclearelectrica or the association.
